title: heavenly golden portuguese fish bake
description: a light and flavorful portuguese dish featuring rolled oats and grilled fish, perfect for a monsoon evening.

ingredients.name: fish fillets (4)
ingredients.notes: any firm white fish works well

instructions: preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
in a shallow dish, mix together the oats, chicken broth, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
add the fish fillets to the oat mixture and coat evenly.
transfer the coated fish fillets to the prepared baking sheet.
brush the tops of the fish with a little extra olive oil and sprinkle with dill.
grill the fish for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
remove the fish from the grill and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
serve the fish hot with a side of steamed vegetables or a green salad.
